title: Contact-Aware Gear: neural-operator surrogate for transient gear-tooth contact stress (code, datasets, trained models and result logs)
description:
Code, processed finite-element datasets, trained model checkpoints and complete per-seed result logs for a Fourier Neural Operator surrogate of the transient stress field in a meshing gear tooth.

The surrogate is trained on 144 converged nonlinear frictional contact cases under a leakage-safe, trajectory-grouped protocol. On held-out trajectories a ten-member seed ensemble with void masking reaches R2 = 0.998 and 4.8% relative L2 error. Re-solving cases at a finer mesh places the labels' own discretization uncertainty at 4.4% in the same metric, so the surrogate error is 1.09 times that floor. The ensemble predicts a case in 27.8 ms on CPU against a median 25.3 s CalculiX solve. The best configuration predicts peak root-fillet stress to 4.1%, under-predicting it by 2.6% on average.

This deposit contains the gearstress package; 49 dataset-generation, training, study and analysis scripts, including the three that reproduce the headline results; the test suite; 12 model-ready HDF5 datasets; the 20 trained checkpoints behind the headline figures; and the per-seed result logs and study summaries. The remaining checkpoints (about 3.4 GB) and raw CalculiX output (about 10 GB) are available on reasonable request.

Source code is released under the MIT License; datasets, result logs and trained checkpoints under CC BY 4.0.
